subject: Matemática
description_pt: Realizar pesquisa envolvendo variáveis categóricas e numéricas, organizar dados coletados por meio de tabelas, gráficos de colunas, pictóricos e de linhas, com e sem uso de tecnologias digitais, e apresentar texto escrito sobre a finalidade da pesquisa e a síntese dos resultados.

components.description_pt: Realizar uma pesquisa coletando dados categóricos ou numéricos
components.description_en: Conduct a survey collecting categorical or numerical data

components.description_pt: Organizar dados coletados em tabelas, gráficos de barras, pictogramas ou gráficos de linhas
components.description_en: Organize collected data in tables, bar graphs, pictographs, or line graphs
components.cc_component_description: Use a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories

components.description_pt: Construir representações de dados com ou sem tecnologias digitais
components.description_en: Construct data displays with or without digital technologies

components.description_pt: Escrever um texto descrevendo o propósito de uma pesquisa e sintetizando seus resultados
components.description_en: Write a text describing the purpose of a survey and synthesizing its results
components.cc_component_description: Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context by describing the nature of the attribute under investigation

cc_matches.description: *Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context, such as by* describing the nature of the attribute under investigation, including how it was measured and its units of measurement.
Represent data with plots on the real number line (dot plots, histograms, and box plots).

Draw a scaled picture graph and a scaled bar graph to represent a data set with several categories. Solve one- and two-step "how many more" and "how many less" problems using information presented in scaled bar graphs. *For example, draw a bar graph in which each square in the bar graph might represent 5 pets.*
